domain.description: Public domain for this install, such as sites.example.com. The stack creates a hosted zone for it.

orgName.description: Organization name shown in the app.

adminEmail.description: First admin. Used once, when the database has no users. Later admins are added in the app or with flagstage admin add.

bedrockModelId.description: Amazon Bedrock model id the editor calls.

region.description: AWS region for the stack, Bedrock, and SES.

sesFrom.description: From address for invite, password reset, and form mail.

logo.description: Path to a logo file, relative to this config file.
